summary.text: Zachary Martin is a Republican candidate for the South Dakota House of Representatives District 32 (2 seats) in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside incumbent Steve Duffy and against incumbent Nicole Uhre-Balk (D) and Independent Samuel Hare.
An entrepreneur with a law degree, Martin said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is campaigning on the cost of living, property taxes and schools.

paragraphs.text: Zachary Martin graduated from Central High School and earned a law degree from the University of Wyoming College of Law in 2022, and his career experience includes working as an entrepreneur, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Martin said Rapid City families are working harder and keeping less and that he would fight to lower the cost of living.
He said he supports small businesses and reducing regulation, and would slow the growth of assessed property valuations without enacting a new sales tax.
He also said he supports strong public schools and local control, and listed recidivism, economic growth, property taxes, school improvement and judicial reform as policy interests.
